description: R3: the rainscreen brief (depth and stagger inputs, thermal-break rule, minimise solar gain); decomposition and the input sliders.
userPrompt: Set up the inputs for a staggered rainscreen facade. Inputs: panel course depth 0.1 to 0.4 m and horizontal stagger 0 to 0.5 of a panel width (both mine). Rule: the thermal break behind the panels must stay continuous. Principle: alternate course depths to break up the facade. Evaluation: minimise solar gain on the south facade, which I will check with an annual radiation study. Start by adding the depth and stagger sliders.
